acceptance_criteria.description: Five named agent configurations are registered with concurrency five and nesting depth one.
evidence: The green scaffold assertion parsed .codex/config.toml and all five role TOML files.
.codex/config.toml registers analyst, architect, implementation, code_quality_test_generator, and reviewer_tester with max_threads=5 and max_depth=1.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each durable role prompt defines purpose, authoritative sources, permitted and prohibited work, handoff fields, and human approval gates.
evidence: The green scaffold assertion verified all six required sections in every workflow/agents prompt.
The iteration visual diff contains the five complete durable prompt files.

acceptance_criteria.description: Agent permissions match the approved plan, including restricted production-code scope for the code-quality/test-case generation agent.
evidence: The green assertion verified read-only for analyst, architect, and reviewer_tester and workspace-write for implementation and code_quality_test_generator.
workflow/agents/code-quality-test-generator.md permits tests/ and assigned workflow evidence, while production-code changes require an explicit human assignment.

acceptance_criteria.description: Workflow documentation plus handoff and evaluation directories exist, and the single session log is updated.
evidence: The green assertion found workflow/README.md, workflow/handoffs/.gitkeep, and workflow/evaluations/.gitkeep.
logs/2026-10-11-project-scaffold.md records Increment 2 and refreshed audit evidence without adding a duplicate session log.

checks.reason: The configuration load check was OK with no strict-schema error, but the whole diagnostic cannot pass in the managed sandbox because provider networking, terminal capabilities, and a user-state database check are unavailable; those failures are unrelated to the project agent configuration.

scope_review.evidence: The 17-file iteration diff contains only the approved agent configuration, durable role prompts, workflow placeholders/guidance, the existing session log update, and ignored TDD evidence. It adds no product behaviour, model pin, external server, deployment action, or dependency.

claims_review.evidence: The session log distinguishes scaffolded roles from invoked agents and accurately records passing checks, the partial environment diagnostic, permissions, human gates, and unresolved dependency-audit finding.
